messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync 10am PT publish target for the release post + changelog tomorrow. Need final docs permalink, a short benchmark stat for the blog, and webinar reg link by EOD.

Ethan (Engineering): Got it. Can we aim a canary freeze at 8:00am PT? There's a minor batching-quibble I'll note in the migration guide (non-breaking).

Ravi (Product): No breaking changes for normal flows. Main user takeaway: smarter routing for short sessions -> lower p95. I'll draft the one-line product blurb.

Noelle (Docs): Draft changelog preview: https://redwood.inference/docs/changelog/v7-preview. Will add migration note once Ethan posts the wording.

Sam (Release): We need a permalink by 6pm PT for the static-site pipeline. If deploy is green we'll merge blog at 9:20am PT for a quick QA window.

Jordan (Events): Webinar slot confirmed 11:00am PT (30m). Need an Eng co-presenter for ~10 mins. Ethan, can you do 11:00-11:10?

Ethan (Engineering): Yes, 11:00-11:10 works. I'll prepare a 2-slide micro-benchmark and export a PNG for social.

Maya (Marketing): Bench copy idea: "up to 35% lower p95 for short-chat workloads" 1 is that defensible?

Ethan (Engineering): 35% is a lab max on tiny samples (<48 tokens). Recommend conservative phrasing: "up to ~28%".

Ravi (Product): Agree with conservative text. Suggested: "up to ~28% lower p95 latency on short-chat workloads (internal benchmark)."

Noelle (Docs): Changelog snippet draft pasted:

```
## v7.0 1 Smarter routing + cache work (2026-08-11)
- Adaptive routing for short-session traffic
- KV prefix cache improvements to lower redundant compute
- Bugfix: stable quantization fallback for mixed-precision paths
```

Maya (Marketing): Nice. Design needs the benchmark PNG by 5:00pm PT for social assets. Ethan, can you upload by 4:30pm? Caption: "internal benchmark 1 p95 latency 1 short sessions".

Ethan (Engineering): Will upload to /drive/marketing/assets by 4:15pm PT. PNG caption will match.

deploy-bot: scheduled_deploy: docs-site job 31212 1 ETA ~10m

Sam (Release): I'll watch the deploy. If green target 9:20am PT merge to give Marketing a 10-min QA before 9:30am staging check and 10:00am publish.

Noelle (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/821 1 includes migration note and prelink.

deploy-bot: docs-site job 31212 1 SUCCESS. Changelog live: https://redwood.inference/docs/changelog/v7.0

Maya (Marketing): Permalink received. I'll queue the blog for 9:20am merge. Social posts scheduled for 10:05am after publish. :rocket: 

Jordan (Events): Webinar reg link live: https://events.redwood.ai/webinar/2026-08-routing-cache 1 speakers updated: Ethan co-presenting. Recording setup confirmed.

Ethan (Engineering): Happy to take live Qs during the webinar channel. Ping me there.

Maya (Marketing): Final checklist: docs permalink (done), changelog live (done), blog + images queued (done), canary freeze 8:00am PT (Ethan), webinar confirmed (Jordan), PRs merged & pipeline green (Sam). Thanks team! :tada:
